newsitem.title: USA: Venture Stores Inc July total sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Venture Stores Inc July total sales rise.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said Tuesday total store sales were $106.1 million in the four weeks ended July 26, up from $99.4 million in the year ago period.
The sales gains primarily reflected strong sales at the 20 stores that have been sold to Kmart Corp and are in the process of holding inventory liquidation sales, the company said.
Venture will not report comparable store sales until after the liquidation sales because of the undue effect the liquidations might have on the results, the company said.

July sales also reflected continued strength in the company's hardlines and home goods departments, as well as strong early sales of back-to-school products, including stationery, backpacks and jeans, the company said.
Venture Stores shares closed up 1/16 at 2-3/16.
